title: Drift
intro: Your ship drifts under emergency lights. Bring the navigation console back online.
win_epilogue: The engines answer, and the ship turns toward home.

cockpit.name: Cockpit
cockpit.description: Stars slide past the dead windows. A dark navigation console waits beside a forgotten coffee mug. The cargo bay is south.
cockpit.sounds: A warning light clicks in the silence.

cargo_bay.name: Cargo Bay
cargo_bay.description: Loose straps sway over a sealed supply crate. A maintenance droid watches from the wall. The cockpit is north.
cargo_bay.sounds: Something small taps inside the crate as the ship drifts.

prybar.name: prybar
prybar.description: A steel bar with a sharp, flattened end.

nav_console.name: navigation console
nav_console.description: The console is dark. Its empty power slot is the size of a battery.

supply_crate.name: supply crate
supply_crate.description: A hard-shell crate with a lid jammed tight.
supply_crate.alt_description: The crate is open, its packing foam torn apart.

power_cell.name: power cell
power_cell.description: A compact power cell glowing electric blue.

maintenance_droid.name: maintenance droid
maintenance_droid.description: A dented repair droid with one patient green eye.

dialogue.text: 'That crate needs leverage,' the droid says. 'A prybar was left in the cockpit.'
The droid points from the power cell toward the navigation console.

interactions.message: The prybar bites under the lid. With one hard pull, the crate snaps open around a glowing power cell.
You slot in the cell. Screens flare awake, engines hum, and the ship begins to turn.
